name: infra-handrail
description: Guards infra work from Claude Code: shows the ambient kube/gcloud/gh/aws/argocd targets, requires named contexts and approved terraform/OpenTofu/terragrunt plans, reads scripts before they run, keeps Secret values from the model, logs changes and watches rollouts.

prodPattern.title: Production pattern
prodPattern.description: Regular expression; a target name that matches is shown as production

namedTargets.title: Named targets
namedTargets.description: When a kubectl, helm, helmfile or argocd command that changes a cluster must name its context: always, only when the ambient one matches prodPattern (production), or never (off)

scriptCheck.title: Script check
scriptCheck.description: When a script that would act on the ambient target waits for your review before it runs: always, only when an ambient target matches prodPattern (production), or never (off)

terraformGate.title: Terraform plan gate
terraformGate.description: terraform, tofu and terragrunt apply only from a saved plan you approved; destroy only after you confirm

secretGuard.title: Refuse printing secrets
secretGuard.description: Refuse commands that would print Kubernetes Secret data or a cloud secret manager's value

allowHelmGet.title: Allow helm get
allowHelmGet.description: Let `helm get values`, `helm get manifest` and `helm get all` run. Turn it on where chart values hold no credentials; rendered Secrets in a manifest are still printed

secretTools.title: Secret tools
secretTools.description: Give Claude secret_rotate, secret_set, secret_keys and leak_check, and withhold output carrying a value they handled. Off: fewer tools in every session

watchTools.title: Watch tools
watchTools.description: Give Claude watch_start and watch_stop for Deployment rollouts and GitHub Actions runs

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: Comma-separated ambient targets to read, show and check for production, from kube, gcloud, gh, aws and argocd. One left out is never read

band.title: Targets above the prompt
band.description: Show the ambient targets in a row above the prompt

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Log infra changes, refusals and Secret writes for /timeline

approveAtPermissionCheck.title: Allow what you approved here
approveAtPermissionCheck.description: A script or plan you approved in this mod's review or dialog is allowed at the permission check instead of being asked about again
